title: Targeted mutation testing
summary: Assess whether important changed-code assertions detect meaningful faults.

sections.label: Published practice
sections.text: Google describes filtered, review-focused mutation testing at scale. It provides an engineering example for incremental use, not evidence that every current Google team uses one identical process.

sections.label: Proposed pilot
sections.text: Apply mutation testing to critical changed logic and inspect surviving mutations. Bound the scope and runner cost before broader adoption.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: The experiment improves useful assertion strength without drowning reviewers in irrelevant mutations.

catalog.applicability: Use when coverage looks high but you doubt that the assertions on important changed logic would catch a real fault. It proposes a bounded pilot that inspects surviving mutations and bounds scope and runner cost before any broader adoption.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
